lines.text: &fThis is your page. It gathers what the server knows about you in one place, so you do not have to go looking for any of it.
&7On the left is you, wearing exactly what you are wearing right now. Change armour or swap what is in your hand and it updates immediately.
&7Your standing on the server. Ranks come from staff, and some of them raise limits elsewhere &8- a prime rank allows more warps and more homes than the default.

&7The server currency. You earn it from daily tasks, quest rewards and by selling to other players through the Auction House or a vending block. You spend it on plots, on paid warps, and on anything another player is selling.
&7How far through the quest book you are. The number counts required quests only &8- hover the line to see how many optional ones you have also finished.
&7Your progression tier, which rises as you complete quests. Tiers gate parts of the pack, so this is the number to watch if something is not available to you yet.
&8Every figure here updates while the hub is open. Nothing needs reopening.
